description: This file implements the VideoFrameYUVMailboxesHolder class, which manages YUV mailboxes for video frames, including creating shared images, converting video frames to mailboxes, and interfacing with Skia for GPU texture handling.

classes.name: VideoFrameYUVMailboxesHolder
classes.description: Manages YUV mailboxes for video frames, including creation, conversion, and cleanup of shared images and textures.

methods.name: ReleaseCachedData
methods.description: Releases cached shared images and textures, destroying shared images if owned.

methods.name: VideoFrameToMailboxes
methods.description: Converts a VideoFrame into YUV mailboxes, creating shared images if necessary.

methods.name: VideoFrameToSkiaTextures
methods.description: Converts a VideoFrame into Skia backend textures for GPU rendering.

methods.name: VideoFrameToSkImage
methods.description: Creates a Skia SkImage from a VideoFrame for GPU rendering.

methods.name: VideoFrameToPlaneSkSurfaces
methods.description: Creates Skia surfaces for each plane of a VideoFrame.

methods.name: ImportTextures
methods.description: Imports textures from mailboxes for GPU use.

methods.name: VideoPixelFormatToSkiaValues
methods.description: Maps VideoPixelFormat to Skia plane configuration and subsampling.

methods.name: VideoFrameGetSkYUVAInfo
methods.description: Retrieves SkYUVAInfo describing the VideoFrame's format and color space.
